evidence.pattern_confirmation: Same substitution class as the first occurrence (ắ collapsed to bare Ă/ă), now observed in a second, unrelated report from a different ticker/pipeline run days apart (this report's earlier units 0000-0022 were refined 2026-07-25/07-28; today's units 0023-0034 refined 2026-07-29). Confidence range on the corrupted units (0.45-0.75) again sits ABOVE the 0.50 ESC-5 auto-escalation floor for most of them, and none of the flags[] arrays flag the label-text corruption specifically (flags present are OCR_quality_variable/critical, image_unavailable, table_structure_complex -- generic quality flags, not a diacritic-specific check).

hypothesis: Reinforces the original hypothesis: root cause is upstream OCR text quality (get_bctc_page_text) or a systematic character-substitution bug in the OCR->refine pipeline that reproduces on 'ắ' specifically, independent of source document. Two occurrences across two different tickers/reports/OCR runs rules out a single-document artifact.
impact_severity: Escalating MED -> HIGH per recurring-bug convention (2+ occurrences of the same defect): this is not an isolated data-quality blip, it appears to affect every BCTC table page refined through this pipeline. Numeric values still appear structurally intact in both reports (this is a label/header-text defect, not a numeric-accuracy defect) but any human-facing rendering of the refined markdown, or a future feature matching chi-tieu by label text rather than ma-so, would be affected fleet-wide.
recommendation: Route to po -> dev-pdf-extractor for root-cause investigation of the OCR->refine text pipeline's handling of the Vietnamese character 'ắ' (U+1EAF, a with breve+acute) specifically -- check whether get_bctc_page_text's OCR engine or a downstream encoding/normalization step is dropping the acute accent while keeping the breve. Given 2 confirmed occurrences already, recommend NOT waiting for a 3rd before prioritizing -- this looks systemic and cheap to root-cause (single character-class bug) relative to its blast radius (every table page, every report, ongoing).
